claim_summaries.summary: For the XXZ two-qubit gate polynomial, strict |gamma|>alpha gives an exact positive Hessian(log q) direction at the all-ones point for any scalar identity shift, provided the gate coefficients are positive. Embedding the gate as a factor in any finite symmetric Trotter product leaves the positive direction in the block-diagonal Hessian of log P, so the Chen-Liu homogeneous-log-concave counting premise fails outside the cone.
claim_summaries.scope_limit: Obstruction to this representation and imported theorem only; no hardness or no-algorithm claim.

claim_summaries.summary: For two sites, Tr(H^3)=24 alpha (b1*b2-alpha*gamma); at alpha=1,gamma=0, fields (1,1) and (1,-1) give +24 and -24, so replacing mixed field signs by absolute values changes the spectrum. A local-Z sign gauge gives a wider admitted signed subclass exactly when its edge and field sign constraints are feasible.
claim_summaries.scope_limit: The trace counterexample blocks sign erasure and a particular gauge route, not all algorithms for mixed-sign inputs.
